submission.natural_language_explanation: A token-identity detector for the space-prefixed two-digit number token ' 39' (strongest, ~0.8-0.95 of max) and, more weakly, ' 38' (~0.5-0.8), ' 48'/' 49' (~0.3-0.5) and ' 36' (~0.35); it fires on that number token itself in any context (ages, counts, percentages, arithmetic) and is near zero (<0.2 of max) on every other token, including other two-digit numbers (' 29', ' 31', ' 37', ' 40', ' 47', ' 93'), multi-digit tokens containing 39 (' 390', ' 1939'), the spelled-out 'thirty-nine', and the no-space '39' token. There is no floor: prompts without one of these number tokens stay below 0.25 of max.
